mission.title: За столом
learning_objectives: Reconstruct shared bread/cup actions without flattening witnesses.
mission.retrieval_targets: Historical source-audited mission relations plus explicit per-node stable destinations.
mission.future_repetition_hooks: Every canonical node uses an explicit terminal retrieval class; no anonymous later hook.
mission.source_classification_notes: Answer-bearing narrative claims are inherited from the source-audited historical mission; R05 repairs semantic pedagogy and traceability without adding historical or doctrinal premises.
mission.disputed_points: Doctrinal interpretation of Eucharistic language is outside required grading; absence in one witness is not contradiction.
textual_variant_points: Luke 22:19b–20: NET Bible, textual-critical (tc) note at Luke 22:19–20 discusses the shorter/longer textual forms; gameplay marks this TX1 and does not force an originality verdict.

Matthew 26:28 and Mark 14:24: NET Bible textual-critical notes discuss variation involving kainēs (new) before covenant; exact-string grading is prohibited and the game preserves witness/text-form scope.
mission.opening_brief: Historical source-audited mission substance retained; canonical records are the machine-checkable product layer.
mission.case_question: Resolve the mission from direct text, witness provenance, comparison, uncertainty and source boundaries.
mission.known_facts_at_start: Only previously audited campaign state and the assigned source corpus.
mission.unknowns_to_resolve: Witness-specific details, source limits, local order, comparison relations and any TX1-sensitive wording.
mission.completion_synthesis: Synoptic table/bread/cup core reconstructed with witness-specific wording and TX1 transparency.
mission.failure_recovery_routes: Every partial/incorrect route returns to the current node after targeted source remediation; no dead ends.
mission.completion_conditions: All required nodes completed independently or guided with provenance/source/TX1 constraints intact.
mission.perfect_investigation_conditions: Required nodes independent plus optional evidence where offered; knowledge performance only, never spiritual ranking.

accessibility.screen_reader_announcement_requirements: Announce node identity, source scope, result, evidence/confidence/TX1, mastery consequence and next action.
accessibility.nonvisual_equivalent: All comparison, ordering, evidence and uncertainty mechanics have labelled linear text/control equivalents.
accessibility.focus_order: Prompt → source scope → controls → feedback → evidence → next action; focus returns predictably after source inspection.
